title: Split progress and report
summary: What happens after the split gate. Each part shows its outcome (decided, answered, pending, settled by a human, not run), its link to the child decision record or research result, and its dependency order, including an edited part and a left-out part. A rejected split gets a plain report: blocked when routing had turned the request away, kept whole (the run goes on) otherwise. Populated from the hand split, the mid-run split, the research split and the rejected split.

provenance.note: Drafted from leafcutter/decisions Decomposition records; styled from the Atlas tokens via docs/ui-context.md (globals.css, tailwind.config.ts, layout.tsx, kit.tsx).
Decisions v4: split also offered when routing would accept the request (bundled_accepted); reject depends on the trigger (blocked, or kept whole).
